prompt: A bank opened 10 branches in a new city. Accounts opened per branch are 40% below plan, while foot traffic is on plan. Which is the strongest initial hypothesis?

options.text: The branches are probably in spots with little passing trade.
options.feedback: Foot traffic is on plan, so people are coming in.

options.text: Awareness of the bank in the new city is likely still low.
options.feedback: Visitors are arriving on plan, so awareness isn't the gap.

options.text: Branch staff are poorly trained, and retraining will fix it.
options.feedback: This states a cause as certain and assumes the fix before any data.

options.text: The products likely don't suit what local visitors need.
options.feedback: Right. Traffic is on plan but accounts are 40% below, so visitors aren't converting. I'd compare conversion by product and customer segment.

explanation: The data shows traffic on plan but accounts 40% below, so visitors aren't converting. Likely cause: the products don't suit local needs. To test it, compare conversion by product and customer segment, and ask what visitors came in for. If conversion is low for every product, look at staff or pricing.
